LeaveRequest.title: Leave request
LeaveRequest.description: An employee request for leave (verlofaanvraag): a period of holiday, sick, unpaid, special, care or parental leave submitted for manager approval. The request lifecycle (draft → submitted → approved/rejected, with the shared no-self-approval separation-of-duties guard) is fully declarative per ADR-031, mirroring the Timesheet and Expense workflows. Leave is the HR/labour surface the portaliq fleet review flagged as missing in hrmq; external employees create and track these requests through the shared external portal (ADR-046), while approval stays a back-office manager action.

submit.description: The employee submits the leave request for manager approval. A rejected request may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the submitted leave request. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the requesting employee).

reject.description: A manager rejects the submitted leave request (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct the request and re-submit.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee domain object who requests the leave (the requester) — a domain-object reference, never a Nextcloud user id (ADR-046 A4). Drives the self-approval guard and scopes the portaliq external-employee view.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave requested, aligned with Dutch HR practice (Wet arbeid en zorg / BW 7): holiday (vakantie), sick (ziekteverlof), unpaid (onbetaald verlof), special (bijzonder verlof), care (zorgverlof), parental (ouderschapsverlof).

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day of the requested leave period (ISO 8601 date).

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the requested leave period, inclusive (ISO 8601 date).

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Optional total number of leave hours requested — for partial-day leave or when the leave balance is administered in hours rather than days.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional free-text motivation for the request (e.g. the occasion for special leave).

status.title: Status
status.description: Approval workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (draft → submitted → approved/rejected).

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the leave request for approval.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: User ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the leave request. Must differ from the requesting employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.title: Approved at
approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the leave request, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.

userId.title: User
userId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this leave request belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service) — a plain NC-user-id string, mirroring the approvedBy convention, never a $ref relation. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried here because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The MijnVerlof self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

managerUserId.title: Manager user id
managerUserId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee's manager (mss-team-scope) — a plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref relation. A copy of the nextcloudUserId of the manager (OrgUnit.managerId) of the record's employee's active OrgAssignment unit, populated by HR/back-office alongside userId because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The TeamVerlofgoedkeuring team page filters on it with the @me token; audited by nl-mss-manager-consistency.

LeaveBalance.title: Leave balance
LeaveBalance.description: Per-employee, per-year, per-leave-type entitlement and usage ledger (verlofsaldo): the statutory plus bovenwettelijk hours granted for a year, the hours used, and a declaratively calculated remaining balance (x-openregister-calculations). Read by the nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum / nl-verlof-saldo-niet-negatief / nl-verlof-vervaltermijn rule checks (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json, leave-verzuim-mvp). usedHours is not yet auto-posted from approved LeaveRequests — that cross-object write hook is a declared follow-up; this MVP records and audits the balance.

remainingHours.title: Remaining hours
remainingHours.description: entitledHours + bovenwettelijkHours − usedHours, evaluated by OpenRegister on save. Declared only here (never as a stored property) so it can never shadow a stored field.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee domain object this leave balance belongs to.

year.title: Year
year.description: Calendar year this leave balance covers.

leaveType.title: Leave type
leaveType.description: The kind of leave this balance tracks, identical to the LeaveRequest.leaveType value set: holiday (vakantie), sick (ziekteverlof), unpaid (onbetaald verlof), special (bijzonder verlof), care (zorgverlof), parental (ouderschapsverlof).

entitledHours.title: Entitled hours
entitledHours.description: Total hours entitled for the year. For statutory holiday leave the minimum is 4x the contractual weekly working time (BW art. 7:634) — checked by nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum against the contractHoursPerWeek snapshot below.

bovenwettelijkHours.title: Bovenwettelijk hours
bovenwettelijkHours.description: Additional (above-statutory) hours granted by contract/CAO on top of the statutory entitlement.

usedHours.title: Used hours
usedHours.description: Hours of this leave type used/taken so far in the year. Recorded from approved LeaveRequests; not yet auto-posted (follow-up). Checked against the total entitlement by nl-verlof-saldo-niet-negatief.

contractHoursPerWeek.title: Contract hours per week
contractHoursPerWeek.description: Snapshot of the employee's contractual weekly working hours at the time this balance was granted. RuleEngine predicates are single-object (no cross-object lookup), so this denormalised snapshot — not a live read of EmploymentContract — drives the nl-verlof-wettelijk-minimum check; left null when not decidable, in which case that check passes vacuously. May legitimately diverge from the employee's current contract after a later contract change — by design, the balance was granted under the hours in force at grant time.

expiryDate.title: Expiry date
expiryDate.description: Date the statutory leave hours of this year lapse — 1 July of the following year (BW art. 7:640a). Checked by nl-verlof-vervaltermijn.
